page.content:
Carpenter who founded the Billund toy workshop and named it LEGO.

How Ole Kirk Christiansen connects

  • Topic: LEGO — Ole Kirk Christiansen founded the Billund workshop and named it LEGO.
  • Faction: The LEGO Group — Ole Kirk's toy shop became The LEGO Group.
  • Location: Billund — Ole Kirk Christiansen built the first LEGO workshop in Billund.

What is Ole Kirk Christiansen?

Ole Kirk Christiansen opened a carpentry shop in Billund, moved from houses to wooden toys, and coined LEGO from the Danish 'leg godt' — play well — before the first plastic bricks.

Key threads lead to LEGO, The LEGO Group and Billund.
